name: print-social-community-feed-on-phone-on-desk-flat-lay
title: Community Instagram profile on a phone beside a mouse, coffee, notebook and books
whatItIs: A wide top-down desk scene with a phone showing a colourful profile grid, a white mouse, a black coffee, fern leaves, headphones, a blue sketch notebook with a white face doodle and stacked books, in a thin brown rounded frame.
whatItMeans: Friendly and studio-like; desk props create a working-day story.
techniques: Style a flat lay with props in the brand blue.
Put the phone off-centre and tilted.
Use light wood or plaster for a neutral base.

vocabulary.definition: A top-down arrangement of desk objects.
Props chosen to match brand colours.
A phone placed at an angle.
A thin dark frame around an image.
